title: Quasi-isomorphisms form a multiplicative system in the homotopy category
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. In the homotopy category $K(\mathcal A)$ of cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$, the class of (homotopy classes of) quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is a multiplicative system: it admits both a left and a right calculus of fractions, and $D(\mathcal A)$ is the corresponding localization of $K(\mathcal A)$.
